description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Lightning] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [Lightning Radiant Shield: 75%] to all allies

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Lightning Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Lightning damage capped at 9999
